page.notes: The line "non debere, probatur." at the top of the right column is the first visible line of that column. The bottom line of the left column is too faint to read and is marked illegible. "Cœlesti" and "Cœna" are read from the printed ligatures and are doubtful. The line at the lower left, outside the index column, is read from a short, tilted fragment and is uncertain. The top line is a fragment of an entry cut at the upper edge. The "Hostiæ" and "Infernum" lines are read as printed.
